topics.caution: The line 'ખભે ભરાવેલી પોટલી ઉપર હાથ રાખી કૂદી પડ્યા' (jumping off the train just as it is about to leave, right after 'ગાડી ઊપડે છે') could read in explanation or real_life_example as an ordinary, even admirable, quick move rather than a real risk.
topics.guidance: In the explanation, keep the jump as part of the boy's helpfulness and hurry, but do not let the real_life_example invite the child to picture themselves jumping on or off a moving train or bus in a rush; anchor the real_life_example instead in the courtesy of helping a stranger with their bags, not in the jumping itself.
